name: Stuttering Movement
hint: When you use the [sbi]When [ v] key pressed[/sbi] event for movement, this could result in stuttering movement.
instruction: Using the [sbi]When [ v] key pressed[/sbi] event for continuous movement can cause stuttering: Depending on how often the key input is registered by the keyboard, your sprite may not move fluidly.[newLine]You can make the movement more consistent by using an [sbi]if < > then[/sbi] block inside a [sbi]forever[/sbi] loop.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when [left arrow v] key pressed :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
move (-5) steps

when [right arrow v] key pressed :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
move (5) steps

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked :: #007000 //⇦  👍
forever
if <key (left arrow v) pressed ?> then
move (-5) steps
end
if <key (right arrow v) pressed ?> then
move (5) steps
end
end
